lxbock.name: Bock Casemates
lxbock.slogan: Count Siegfried's rock, hollowed out into a labyrinth.
lxbock.line: The best fortress in Europe after Gibraltar.
lxbock.by: Lazare Carnot, to the French National Convention, on Luxembourg

lxcorniche.name: Chemin de la Corniche
lxcorniche.slogan: A promenade on the old ramparts, with the Grund far below.
lxcorniche.line: The most beautiful balcony of Europe.

lcviandencastle.name: Vianden Castle
lcviandencastle.slogan: A ruin that was sold for scrap and rebuilt stone by stone.
lcviandencastle.line: King William I sold it in 1820 to a buyer who stripped it; the State's restoration began in 1977 and finished in 1990.

lcbasilica.name: Echternach Basilica
lcbasilica.slogan: Willibrord's abbey, risen again after the 1944 blast.
lcbasilica.line: Retreating German troops blew up part of the basilica on 26 December 1944; it was re-consecrated in 1953.

lcbelval.name: Belval Blast Furnaces
lcbelval.slogan: Rust-red giants over a steel town turned university campus.
lcbelval.line: The last blast furnace at Esch-Belval closed in July 1997, freeing 120 hectares for redevelopment.
